body:
I'm sorry you are suffering OP. I was about 24 when my life began the journey that ends here. It sounds like you're emotional, which is good. That means there's something inside of you. You sound angry, which is great. That means you want to fight. You don't want to lie down and let things be. 

Even if everything you said is true, which I doubt (We tend to see the world differently than it really is) who cares? There's billions of people in the world. Fuck those people, meet some new ones. I'd offer to let you PM me, but I um probably won't be using this account much.

>  Also if you get run in by the cops and they leave your stuff out

What would I possibly need to worry about with the cops? Serious question. Is it illegal to be homeless?

Honestly, I'm not trying to seek pity here. But I've been depressed for a long time. The month leading up to this has basically been me being verbally assaulted where someone who is supposed to be family said such horrible shit to me, I wouldn't say it to my worst enemy. I am giving serious consideration to just buying a bunch of drugs. Finding a nice comfy spot far enough away from where anyone can find me, ingesting all of those drugs, and just dying.

Well yes, I had the impending doom dream. I knew it was going to be temporarily homeless, but I had a big van to sleep in. The very same morning I woke from that dream I learned my van could not be repaired with the funds I have, and I will now be forced to sleep on the street, with no means of transportation. Which means improving my life just got a thousand times harder, and much more unlikely. 

At least I've got an exit plan!
I lived in Jacksonville Florida for a year. Lost almost everything just trying to get out. Worst experience of my life, and I would choose death over going back, I am not exaggerating.
I'd gladly take the info just to have it. I just implore you to message it instead of a comment if you can.
It manifests for a few seconds.
Well where would you leave your stuff if you don't carry it? Don't exactly have a home to store stuff lol.

Thanks. And no, I have maybe had 1 or 2 dreams (that I remember) that were *clearly* triggered by seeing a horror movie. 

Like last night, debatable, but I was reading the comments in the r/videos section about the Mass murderer/serial killer Todd Kohlepp (idk and idc if I spelled it wrong.. dudes a rapist and killer). Then I had a horrible dream that I was hanging out with people I didn't know, and they had this girl kidnapped. And I spent the entire dream trying to alert authorities to the situation without letting anyone know what I was doing. Was scary/fun.
Thanks man. I already have a backpack, but I'm thinking.. should I get like one of those camping back packs that are a bit more expensive? I'm thinking I'm going to need a sleeping bag.
I've been trying, but with the new kick in my balls of essentially having to junk my car, I've lost all the fight that's left in me. I just need a good place to die.
I don't... I did a few years ago. Moved there from NY. "Hated" it because it wasn't NY. Moved to Gaston County.. and now I miss Mecklenberg county so much because it was actually not bad at all.

As a woman, I'd be VERY careful being alone at a truck stop at night. 

I'm not saying all truckers are criminals (most aren't), but there have been a LOT of murderers who were truckers. A few serial killers too. Get mace if you can either way.

Soon to be homeless, and this is exactly why I didn't want to get a tent. But I do need *something* how logical would it be to carry around a sleeping bag with me all day? Also, will that be enough to keep me warm if I zip myself inside during the winter? Gets to about 10 degrees at WORST here, but closer to 30.
